ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black) pixels, approximately 85:15 across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region is dominated by a contiguous high-intensity light-colored field. Low-intensity black pixels are mapped as a continuous band along the trailing edges and the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a wide obtuse angle; depth is shallow relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge presents a mostly smooth continuous boundary with low-amplitude pixel variations; minor irregular peaks are localized at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves characterize the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in acute points.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct black terminal border along the entire trailing edge creates a high-contrast boundary with the sea surface.
